robot: KUKA iiwa 14 arm with a 22-joint Sharpa HA4 left hand on its flange (DexToolBench scene, MuJoCo): 29 joint position targets

frame.base_text: the scene's world frame (z up), not the arm's base: the table's centre is at x = y = 0 with its top at z = 0.53 m, and the iiwa's base stands at (0, 0.8, 0); no part here takes an end-effector pose

arm.note: the iiwa's joint1..joint7 (rad); it starts at (-1.571, 1.571, 0, 1.376, 0, 1.485, 1.308)

left_hand.note: the Sharpa HA4 left hand's 22 joints (rad): thumb CMC_FE, CMC_AA, MCP_FE, MCP_AA, IP; index, middle and ring MCP_FE, MCP_AA, PIP, DIP; pinky CMC, MCP_FE, MCP_AA, PIP, DIP; all 0 at the start (open)

resets.note: Each episode starts from the same frozen state (robot, tool and goals); only the last episode is graded, and reaching every goal ends the run at once.

notes: The arm and the hand take joint positions only: there is no end-effector pose command and no kinematics service here, so placing the hand or the tool means choosing the iiwa's 7 joint angles (limits in describe_robot). Rows are one control step apart (1/60 s) and each row's targets are held or ramped linearly between rows. The goals are shown in the images as a green ghost copy of the tool, one goal at a time in order; the current goal counts as reached when the tool closely matches the ghost's pose, and the next one then appears. Goals have no time limit; the episode ends when every goal is reached, at its control-step limit, or when your time is up. Time passes only inside calls.
